assessment.summary: Export acknowledgement can precede storage. AR1 remains accepted.
assessment.validation: openspec validate persist-export passed; runtime behavior was not tested.

findings.title: Success can precede durable storage
findings.evidence: src/export.js acknowledges a request before its write completes.
findings.impact: A caller can receive success for a missing export.
findings.requiredChange: Align the contract, design, work, and verification on durable acknowledgement.

acceptedRisks.title: Legacy rollback remains manual
acceptedRisks.evidence: The legacy deployment has no automatic rollback path.
acceptedRisks.potentialImpact: Recovery takes longer during the deprecation window.
acceptedRisks.acceptanceRationale: Automation costs more than the bounded remaining exposure.
acceptedRisks.reopenWhen: The deprecation deadline is extended or new legacy deployments appear.
acceptedRisks.acceptanceAuthority: The change owner explicitly accepted manual rollback in the review discussion.

reviewCoverage: Reviewed export persistence, failure handling, callers, and legacy rollback.
